home.gardenDescription: Notes, thoughts, and derivations. A digital garden.

research.description: My undergraduate research focuses on Quantum Information Science.

papers.title: Energy-Scaled Zero Noise Extrapolation for Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Code
papers.description: Theoretical and numerical study of Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes under pure-loss decoherence. Developed an energy-scaled zero-noise extrapolation method for quantum error mitigation in bosonic codes. Paper in preparation. Manuscript draft in attachment.

papers.title: Contextual Quantum Fisher Information Verification
papers.description: Verified theoretical framework of contextual quantum Fisher information through numerical simulations and compared performance versus traditional QFI in metrology applications. Note in attachment.

items.title: Badger Solar Car Optimization
items.description: Numerical simulation and optimization system for a solar-powered race car. Implemented receding horizon control and modeled electrical/mechanical components (Solar Array, BMS, Resistive Forces) in MATLAB & Simulink.

items.title: Campus Dining Optimization
items.description: A Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) project for optimizing weekly restaurant choices under constraints of time, money, and nutrients. Top Course Project for ISyE 524.

items.title: Multi-Qubit Crosstalk Simulation
items.description: Winner of Quantum + Chips 2025 Hackathon. Simulated a 3-qubit system coupled under a driving magnetic field to observe crosstalk and mitigated it using a compensation Hamiltonian.

items.title: Brachistochrone FEA Solution
items.description: Numerical solution to the classical Brachistochrone problem using Finite Element Analysis with P2 element discretization. Applied Gaussian quadrature and L-BFGS-B optimization.

items.title: Deep-time Steps: Patterns of Wear
items.description: Stochastic model to simulate stair wear patterns based on probabilistic pedestrian behavior. Trained a CNN on the simulation to analyze usage patterns.

garden.description: A collection of notes, derivations, and thoughts. Not quite a blog, but a growing repository of knowledge.
